title: createTelegramAlertSink has zero throttle, unlike the sibling TelegramNotifier it is supposed to match -- a repeated /health probe re-sends a live Telegram alert on every single hit with no rate limit
evidence: packages/core/src/alerts/alert-sink.ts's notifyWatchSilent(): every call unconditionally builds the message and fires `send(token, chatId, text)` -- no lastSentAt/key-based gate of any kind. Compare packages/meeting-bot/src/capture/telegram-alerts.ts's createTelegramNotifier(), which routes every notify* call (including this exact method) through notify-channels.ts's createNotifier(), whose DEFAULT_THROTTLE_MS = 60_000 collapses repeated same-key sends within 60s to one -- that file's own header states the reason: 'so a flapping connection... cannot spam the phone.' The caller, apps/api/src/routes/health.ts's detectSilentWatchers(), also carries no state-based throttle: it iterates the configured source types on every /health hit and calls deps.notifyWatchSilent() for every row still stale, with no memory of a prior call. Verified live: a throwaway node:test probe (detectSilentWatchers with a single stale 'drive' row, expectedSourceTypes:['drive'], called twice in a row with a recording notifyWatchSilent fake) recorded exactly 2 separate calls -- confirmed further that with the real default expectedSourceTypes (3 types) and only 1 row present, 2 detectSilentWatchers() calls produce 6 alerts (3 stale source types x 2 calls), not 2, because 'no row at all' is also stale. Probe file was a throwaway addition to the worktree, deleted after the run; git hash-object confirms apps/api/src/routes/health.ts, packages/core/src/alerts/alert-sink.ts and apps/api/src/production.ts all match HEAD after the probe.
fix_direction: Give createTelegramAlertSink() the same generic per-key backstop throttle notify-channels.ts already provides meeting-bot's side (a Map<key, lastSentAt> keyed on `watchSilent:${tenantId}:${sourceType}`, default ~60s, injectable `now()` for tests) -- the smallest change that brings the two 'matching' implementations back into actual behavioural parity, not just matching wording. Alternatively/additionally, health.ts's detectSilentWatchers could carry a caller-side state-based throttle once U6 starts scheduling repeated probes, matching notifyPollFailed's documented division of responsibility (state-based dedup is the caller's job, the generic time throttle is the notifier's backstop) -- today neither layer has any throttle at all for this alert.
reproductions: node:test probe against detectSilentWatchers() with expectedSourceTypes:['drive'] and one stale row, called twice -> notifyWatchSilent fake recorded 2 calls (no throttle).
Read packages/core/src/alerts/alert-sink.ts notifyWatchSilent() -- no lastSentAt state, no key, no throttleMs parameter anywhere in the file.

Read packages/meeting-bot/src/capture/notify-channels.ts:60-85 -- createNotifier()'s `throttled(key)` + `lastSentAt` Map, DEFAULT_THROTTLE_MS = 60_000, applied to every notify* call including notifyWatchSilent.
notes: Not charged as a blocker for this unit's own claim -- 'R2 reaches 1/1 on alert delivery' is true and verified; a single alert correctly reaches Telegram, is correctly redacted on failure, and correctly never throws into the /health probe. This is a reliability/alert-fatigue gap, not a delivery failure or a credential leak, filed HIGH rather than blocking because the failure mode it opens is the same CLASS the whole R2 feature exists to prevent (D-046: an operator who gets spammed on every poll while a watcher stays down is likely to mute the channel, which is functionally the same blindness as no alert at all) and because the very next planned unit on this feature (U6, Task Scheduler, gated separately) is specifically about making something call /health on a schedule -- at which point this stops being latent. Nothing currently schedules /health (D-053/D-048, not charged), so no live spam is possible in the deployed state today; this is a real defect in the code shipped by this unit, not a hypothetical future one, and should be closed before or alongside U6 rather than discovered live.
